note: Development questions for tuning the similarity floor, top-k, prompts and the groundedness threshold. Separate from the frozen evaluation cases: no question here repeats or paraphrases an evaluation question (a test checks for overlap). Results on this set may be used to change settings; results on the evaluation set may not. D1 ("How late can I cancel without a charge?") was used while building Step 9 and is NOT in this set, because it means the same as evaluation cases A1 and A6.

questions.question: How much is the fee for late cancellations?
Up to how many hours before the visit can I move it to another time?
Can I get reminders by email instead of text?
How early should I join a video visit?
How long does the clinic take to send me a copy of my data?
How soon is an approved refund paid back?
Is there free parking at the clinic?
Which doctors work at the clinic?
What is the clinic's wifi password?
Should I take my blood pressure medication on the morning of my visit?
Do reminders include my test results?
